text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is trying hard at weight
loss
training, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To think, running gets this tough from
gaining just
a little weight.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I can't do it like before... I've lost my full
poweeer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
Then let's go full power at getting you back on
track!

text_block_list.text:
What?! Of course... I've just gotta go...
all out!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Raaaah! This weight means nothing to
me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I need to get my full power back! I won't
let
anything hold me down!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Work hard, me! Don't lose, me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит devotes herself to
running, and
soon finds herself back in
excellent shape!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
